episodes.synopsis: A young man gets a dream job as producer for an entire unit of idols. There's just one catch, though: they're all in elementary school!
episodes.title: When Can't You See Your Own Face in the Mirror?

episodes.synopsis: Nina loses something very important to her, and the entire Third Entertainment Division comes together to help her get it back.
episodes.title: What says 'I'm Home' even though it's leaving?

episodes.synopsis: The Third Entertainment Division gets its first public exposure when Miria goes on an internet livestream.
episodes.title: What Sinks in the Ocean and Doesn't Get Wet?

episodes.synopsis: Momoka gets a request to be on a daytime television show, but the person they want to see isn't who she really is. Is she willing to change who she is to become a star?
episodes.title: What Flies With Broken Wings?

episodes.synopsis: Risa gets her first shot at being in a movie. She works hard for the audition, but...
episodes.title: What's Really High But Underground?

episodes.synopsis: Haru is given a chance to be a backup dancer, but refuses to wear the girly outfit. Is being an idol what she truly wants to do?
episodes.title: What Gets Cooler The Hotter It Gets?

episodes.synopsis: It's a big day for Koharu as she goes to the zoo with her special friend, a pet iguana.

episodes.title: What Has Its Face Come Out When it's Warm?

episodes.synopsis: The girls of the Third Entertainment Division perform their first song as they aim for their big debut.
episodes.title: What Color Gets Bigger the More You Bring It Together?

episodes.title: What's the Difference Between Grown-Ups and Kids?

episodes.synopsis: The senior idols will have a great concert, but the U149 girls won't be able to participate! Can an unusual encounter change this desolate scenario? And if it changes, will everyone be able to get the new idol group on stage in time?!
episodes.title: What can't be seen when it's bright out, but can be seen when it's nighttime?
